schema.title: Emission Calculation Model Argument
schema.description:
The assignment of an Emission Argument (Emission Activity Parameter or Emission Factor) as input or
output of a Calculation Model. An argument type is required to determine if the argument is an
Emission Activity Parameter or Emission Factor.

id.description: Unique identifier of an OSDU record.

version.description: Version number of this OSDU record.

id.description: The Primary Key assigned to the Emission Calculation Model Argument.

emission_calculation_model_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Emission Calculation Model.

emission_calculation_component_line_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Emission Calculation Formula Component.

emission_calculation_formula_id.description: The optional part of a composite Foreign Key identifying the Emission Calculation Formula Component (the Emission Calculation Formula).

emission_factor_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Emission Factor used by a Emission Calculation Model.

emission_factor_type_id.description: The optional part of a composite foreign identifying the Emission Factor (the Emission Factor Type).

physical_quantity_type_id.description: The optional part of a composite Foreign Key identifying the Emission Factor (the Physical Quantity Type).

emission_parameter_type_id.description: DEPRECATED, replace by Physical Quantity Type. Optional part of a composite foreign key for the Emission Factor. The Emission Parameter Type.

emission_activity_parameter_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Emission Activity Parameter used by the Emission Calculation Model.

emission_activity_id.description: The optional part of a composite Foreign Key used to identify the Emission Activity Parameter (the Emission Activity).

parameter_physical_quantity_type_id.description: The optional part of a composite Foreign Key identifying the Emission Activity Parameter (the Physical Quantity Type).

emission_activity_parameter_type_id.description: DEPRECATED, Replace by Physical Quantity Type. Optional part of a composite foreign key used to identify the Emission Activity Parameter. The Emission Activity Parameter Type

emission_argument_id.description: The Foreign Key identifying the Emission Calculation Argument as either an Emission Activity Parameter or Emission Factor.

emission_argument_type.description: The Emission Calculation Argument Type: Emission Activity Parameter or Emission Factor.
